core.title: Technical Specification for Scientific Dataset Metadata Registration
core.description: A recommended technical specification defining metadata registration elements, identifier rules, quality-control requirements, and exchange formats for scientific datasets.
contributors: National Science and Technology Infrastructure Center
funders: National Key Research and Development Program of China, 2024YFF0600100

standard_literature_information.Issuing Agency: State Administration for Market Regulation; Standardization Administration of China
standard_literature_information.Chinese Standard Name: 科学数据集元数据注册技术规范
standard_literature_information.Original Standard Name: Technical Specification for Scientific Dataset Metadata Registration
standard_literature_information.English Standard Name: Technical Specification for Scientific Dataset Metadata Registration
standard_literature_information.Drafting Organization: National Science Data Standards Committee; National Science and Technology Infrastructure Center; Institute of Scientific and Technical Information of China
standard_literature_information.Chinese Abstract: 本标准规定了科学数据集元数据注册的核心元素、领域扩展元素、CSTR 标识符填写规则、数据质量声明和机器可读交换格式。
standard_literature_information.English Abstract: This standard specifies core and domain metadata elements, CSTR identifier rules, quality statements, and machine-readable exchange formats for scientific dataset registration.
standard_literature_information.English Subject Terms: scientific dataset; metadata; registration; persistent identifier
